subject: Sizing follow-up: Dedicated capacity hypothesis & next steps
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@pivotal-retail.com>, Tom Keller <tkeller@pivotal-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo notes + quick sizing asks

Hi Elena, Tom — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a Dedicated pool and validate Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC tradeoffs for Pivotal Retail.

Recap (from our note takers):
- Primary workload: customer support + product search re-ranking + personalization, peak traffic coincides with US business hours.
- Latency target: 90th < 250ms for short-chat flows, 95th < 600ms for long-runner re-ranks.
- Current delivery expectation: predictable throughput (no bursty failures) and strict data isolation (logs retained 3 years).

What would help us next: (two small asks)
1) Can you confirm peak concurrent sessions and expected average tokens per request (we got a rough 1200 tokens avg, but need a distribution)? I've attached a small worksheet — pivotal_gpu_requirements.xlsx — that helps map TPS/concurrency to GPU choices.
2) Any procurement constraints on vendor GPU families? (e.g., preference for H100 vs A100, cloud region limits, or must-be-on-prem policy).

Tentative hypothesis (what we'll validate): a mixed Dedicated pool with an H100-heavy tier for re-ranking (high throughput / long sequences) and A100s for chat/personalization gives the best latency vs cost. We'll run a back-of-envelope in the next 48 hours and follow up with a recommended pool and a POC plan.

Next steps: please upload the traffic snapshot or reply inline with the numbers for avg tokens, 50/95/99 token percentiles, and peak TPS. I'll loop Ben and Marissa on configuration details after your numbers come in.

Thanks —
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales (Dedicated & Private)
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0147

Attachment: pivotal_gpu_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet template: peak TPS, avg tokens, token percentiles, concurrency targets)

Hi Rohan — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching a CSV with a short traffic snapshot and answers inline.

Quick answers:
- Peak TPS (inbound requests hitting LLM): 160 TPS sustained during peak hour (US East).
- Peak concurrent sessions: ~220 concurrent conversational sessions during peak.
- Token mix: median 380 tokens, mean 620 tokens, 95th percentile ~1,850 tokens (re-ranking jobs drive the long tail).
- Sequence types: ~65% chat/assistant (short-medium sequences), ~25% rerank (high token workloads), ~10% batch embedding/analytics (off-peak).
- Data isolation: must be VPC-isolated; on-prem is acceptable but preferred to start with Dedicated in cloud-private (dedicated GPUs, customer VPC).

Procurement/constraints: we can accept common cloud GPU families, but preference for vendor-managed instances — if hardware is substantially cheaper on-prem we'll consider it. Procurement will want a line-item for SLA and quarterly reporting.

Attachments: pivotal_traffic_snapshot.csv

If you can draft a recommended Dedicated pool suggestion (GPU types + slot counts + expected 95th latency) that would help our infra/finance teams evaluate.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of ML Ops, Pivotal Retail
Elena.Torres@pivotal-retail.com

Rohan/Marissa — quick technical read based on Elena's numbers. Notes and a conservative configuration below.

Summary of constraints from snapshot:
- Sustained 160 TPS, 220 concurrent sessions.
- Heavy tail: 25% rerank with long sequences (~1850 tokens 95th).

Conservative Dedicated pool (target: 95th latency SLOs):
- Rerank pool: 6x H100-80GB (or 8x A100-80GB if H100 not available). Expect ~110-160 rps per H100 depending on batching and kv-cache behavior for rerank sequences (batching helps but tail still costly).
- Chat/personalization pool: 4x A100-80GB with aggressive KV cache and prefix caching (aim for 150-200 qps per GPU for short sequences).
- Embeddings/batch: 1-2x cheaper GPUs (A10/T4) for off-peak batch jobs.

Concurrency & token handling:
- Concurrency per GPU: plan for ~8-12 simultaneous inferences for long sequences; short chat can multiplex higher using continuous batching.
- Token mix: suggest enabling int8 quantization for chat tier to reduce memory footprint; keep rerank on fp16/higher-precision for quality unless they allow evals.

Estimated 95th latency (back-of-envelope):
- Rerank (95th): 350-650ms on H100 w/ batching and KV cache; A100 higher variance (500-900ms) unless you accept larger pool.
- Chat (95th): 120-260ms on A100 with proper batching/caching.

Operational notes:
- Because Pivotal needs VPC isolation, propose a Dedicated-in-VPC design (private control plane + reserved GPUs).
- We'll provide a POC plan: 2-week pilot with synthetic replay of the provided snapshot to validate batch profiles and 95/99 latency.

I've dropped a short rec of these numbers into ben-gpu-recs.txt attached. If you want, I can convert to a costed SKU mix for procurement next.

Ben Carter

Elena / Tom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the snapshot. Based on Ben's conservative config, here's a succinct recommendation and the proposed next steps for procurement/POC: 

Recommendation (high level):
- Start with a Dedicated-in-VPC deployment. This keeps control-plane simplicity and meets your data isolation requirement while enabling us to tune latency & cost.
- Initial pool: 6 H100-80GB (rerank) + 4 A100-80GB (chat) + 1 A10 (batch/embeddings). We can provide an A100-only fallback if H100 is restricted by procurement.
- Expected SLOs: 95th latency ~350-650ms for rerank on H100 pool; 95th latency ~150-280ms for chat on A100 with KV/prefix caching and batching tuned during POC.

Immediate next steps:
1) I'll attach a short proposal (redwood-dedicated-proposal-PR-2027.pdf) with SKU counts and an initial cost estimate — please share with procurement.
2) Approve a 2-week pilot window and share a test dataset/replay window (we can run the CSV snapshot in staging).
3) Decide on GPU family preference (H100 preferred for rerank; A100 ok). If procurement absolutely restricts to A100 we will provide an updated cost/latency estimate.

If that sounds good I can schedule a 30-minute procurement + infra sync for later this week to walk through the SKU lines and SLA items.

Thanks — looking forward.
